# Messaging Service

## Purpose
The Messaging Service provides a unified interface for sending and managing notifications across different communication channels. It handles message templating, routing, and history tracking, ensuring that users receive relevant updates via their preferred delivery methods (e.g., email, SMS, push notifications).

## Endpoints

| Controller | Endpoint | Method | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chat** | `/plugins/Chat/getAllChats` | POST | Lists all active chats. |
| **Chat** | `/plugins/Chat/createChat` | POST | Starts a new conversation. |
| **Message** | `/plugins/Message/getAllMessages` | POST | Fetches message history for a chat. |
| **Message** | `/plugins/Message/createMessage` | POST | Sends a new message. |

## Dependencies
- **messaging-model**: Core data structures.
- **flexicore-boot**: Plugin infrastructure.
- **messaging-firebase-service** (Optional): For push notifications.

## Interesting Features
- **Multi-Device Support**: Messages can be synchronized across multiple `MessageReceiverDevice` entities.
- **WebSocket Integration**: Real-time message delivery to active clients.

## Operation Flow
```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Controller as MessageController
    participant Service as MessageService
    participant WS as WebSocketHandler

    User->>Controller: sendMessage(MessageCreate)
    Controller->>Service: createMessage(MessageCreate)
    Service->>WS: broadcastToChat(Message)
    WS-->>User: Message Received
```
